rv.q: Well acted if not exactly captivating, Shear Madness is as insubstantial as Trump's coiffure.
The game-playing structure of the show is cleverly designed and very well executed.
It has taken 35 years for Shear Madness to make it to New York -- and now we know why.
The show is very entertaining and extremely funny.
Groan away, but there are so many you'll eventually have to crack a smile.
For SHEAR MADNESS to click with Manhattan ticket buyers, its script would benefit from some trimming, shaping and styling.
How this show has attracted audiences for over 35 years is the real mystery to me.

cn.t: After 35 years of success elsewhere, this interactive murder-mystery comedy finally arrives in New York to mixed reviews. Critics find it charming but not quite sharp enough for Manhattan, though the improv-savvy cast earns praise.
